events.description: A robotics challenge testing autonomous navigation, sensor integration, and control logic. Participants design and program robots to follow designated paths or navigate complex mazes with precision, accuracy, and efficiency.

A head-to-head robotic combat challenge in which participants engineer robots to push their opponents out of a designated arena while maintaining stability and control. The event tests mechanical design, traction, strategy, and real-time decision-making.

A vision-based robotics challenge focused on navigating low-visibility environments using ESP-CAM technology. Participants apply embedded systems, image processing, and autonomous control to detect paths and navigate through dark or challenging terrain.

A robotics challenge combining object gripping, payload handling, and speed-based navigation. Participants design and control robots to retrieve designated objects, transport them securely, and complete the course with precision and efficiency.

A creative robotics challenge in which participants build and program robots capable of reproducing drawings, patterns, or designs on a surface. The event combines mechanical design, motor control, and programming accuracy to transform robotic motion into artistic expression.
